COR_PRI: Primary and initial where statute specifies
COR_SEC: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute

codebook.question: What credentials and other conditions govern entry?
codebook.decision_rule: Record credentials, nationality/residence and other restrictions; preserve exceptions. Do not infer contemporary enforceability.

codebook.question: How are entrants selected and ranked?
codebook.decision_rule: Distinguish a credentials/antecedents competition from an obligatory examination. Record priority rules and exceptional routes.

codebook.question: What stability protection and appointment-confirmation route is specified?
codebook.decision_rule: Record titular versus temporary scope; do not equate a general stability clause with immediate tenure for every employee.

codebook.question: What grounds and procedures can lead to removal?
codebook.decision_rule: Record performance, discipline and redundancy separately. Due process is not proof of implementation or an absolute dismissal prohibition.

codebook.question: How are higher hierarchical posts filled?
codebook.decision_rule: Focus on hierarchy, not ordinary transfers. Record separate governing laws and exceptions.

codebook.question: Are minimum service years required for promotion?
codebook.decision_rule: Record thresholds as printed by target role and branch. Missing implementing law means incomplete coverage, not no threshold.

codebook.question: Does the supplied text specify a seniority pay schedule?
codebook.decision_rule: Record percentage, service years and calculation base. Do not confuse statutory schedule percentages with current take-home pay.

codebook.question: Is an additional payment explicitly conditional on training or attendance?
codebook.decision_rule: Code monetary conditions separately from teaching-performance evaluation, absence deductions, geography pay and promotion points.

codebook.question: Is professional appraisal prescribed and how often?
codebook.decision_rule: Record appraiser, evidence and scope; an annual requirement does not demonstrate actual appraisal quality.

codebook.question: Does appraisal affect eligibility or ranking for promotion?
codebook.decision_rule: Distinguish eligibility threshold, ranking factor, and removal sanction. Do not infer that removal provisions determine promotion.

codebook.question: Can teachers inspect and challenge their appraisal?
codebook.decision_rule: Record authority, route and statutory deadline where available. Do not transfer deadlines across procedures.

codebook.question: Are distinct professional ranks for classroom teachers specified?
codebook.decision_rule: Requires a formal higher classroom-teacher grade while retaining ordinary teaching as the core role. Seniority pay, more hours, transfers, coordinators and management posts do not alone qualify.

codebook.question: What duty to develop and institutional support are prescribed?
codebook.decision_rule: Record teacher obligations and authority support separately; a policy aspiration is not a guaranteed annual training allocation.

codebook.question: Are further study or training recognized in career assessment?
codebook.decision_rule: Separate the right to study from points/credit for completed training. Record where scoring is delegated.

codebook.question: What leave entitlement or framework is specified?
codebook.decision_rule: Distinguish a statutory right, discretionary permission, and a union guidance summary. Do not infer days from an absent regulation.

codebook.question: How are substitutes selected and continuity managed?
codebook.decision_rule: Record eligibility, selection, coverage timing and cessation. A short absence threshold is not the same as a prohibition on replacement.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Entry as titular requires a qualifying teaching credential, fitness and conduct conditions, and statutory eligibility requirements. The text allows foreign applicants subject to residence and Spanish requirements.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 57 also prints an initial-entry age ceiling of 50 with exceptions. Record it as supplied text, not a verified restriction in force in 2026; a transitory credential exception is also printed.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Base-post recruitment uses a competition of credentials and antecedents, with appointments following the merit list.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 59 contains an exception for third-category directors where serving staff show no interest; tertiary hour posts have a separate examination rule and are outside this primary case.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Titular staff have conditional stability. Initial titular-interino appointment continues until a fitness examination and an appraisal of at least 6 points are passed.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The first eligible school year is used for appraisal; appraisal requires at least three months for titular interino under article 130. Provisional and substitute employees do not receive the same stability right.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Loss of stability includes specified low-appraisal thresholds, discipline and exhaustion of availability; serious disciplinary sanctions require prior proceedings and defense rights.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 18(b): two appraisals below 6 in five years or one below 4 lead to investigation and a disciplinary-tribunal opinion before cessation. Availability may last five years, with only the first paid under article 22.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Most listed leadership and inspection promotions require credentials, antecedents and an examination; other listed posts use credentials and antecedents only.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Titular promotion differs from temporary assignment of hierarchical functions (article 75). Article 81 sets a maximum two-year interval subject to an approved-candidate exception.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: General promotion eligibility requires titular status, active service and appraisal conditions, but this supplied statute delegates further post-specific requirements.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: No comparable role-specific service-year schedule is established here; obtain the regulation under article 80(d) before coding a numeric threshold. Do not enter zero.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Article 33 specifies seniority increments on the assignment for the post or teaching hours: 50% at 10 years and 120% at 24 years.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The entire printed schedule must not be treated as current payroll. Article 34 regulates recognized service and adjustment; additional remuneration components are separate.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: No positive training- or attendance-conditioned additional payment was identified in the supplied remuneration provisions.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 125 provides deductions for unjustified absence and lateness; that is a penalty, not a positive incentive. Later salary agreements or regulations were not supplied in this case.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Titular, titular-interino, provisional and substitute staff are appraised annually by their hierarchical superior using a professional record.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 130 defers appraisal during unresolved investigations and excludes service shorter than 30 days (three months for titular interino). This is a prescribed process, not proof of actual practice.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Promotion eligibility requires at least 8 points in each of the last two appraised years. Appraisal also enters the classification formula.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 51 multiplies the average appraisal by credentials plus seniority; minimum eligibility and ranking are distinct mechanisms.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Teachers can inspect and challenge their professional record and seek revocation of an appraisal with hierarchical appeal to the central classification tribunal.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 129 names the appraisal appeal route. General article 161 sets ten days from notification; article 165 states working-day computation. Verify implementing procedure before practical use.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: No distinct advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the supplied career ladder.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The ladder lists base teachers and higher hierarchical roles; specialized-function bonuses and more teaching hours do not alone establish advanced classroom ranks. Search scope: articles 11-16,31-39,69-88 and 171.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Teachers have a duty to improve their pedagogical preparation; authorities must encourage and facilitate professional development through centers, scholarships, courses and other measures.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 171 includes in-school training for active teachers. This is not a verified annual training entitlement of a specified number of hours.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Additional credentials and qualifying certificates count as valued entry antecedents; specialist titles and certificates retain their validity and points across the career.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The detailed numerical scale is delegated. Credit is not evidence that the training improves classroom practice.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Articles 114-116 list leave causes and permit study/professional-development leave, with duration and conditions delegated to regulation.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 115 is discretionary (may grant). The PDF carries an emergency-law note above article 114; current effect is unresolved. Do not infer paid duration from these articles.

coding.education_scope: Primary; general statutory provisions apply
coding.summary_en: Provisional and substitute appointments use classification lists, with a complementary list when qualified candidates are unavailable or decline. Substitutes normally cease when the absent employee returns.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Provisional service does not itself confer titular status (article 111). The supplied chapter does not specify a universal minimum absence or guaranteed replacement deadline.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: The supplied text requires appropriate official credentials, fitness, nationality/residence conditions and application to statutory competitions; primary credentials are specified in article 62.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 61 prints an age maximum of 40, with an exception for certain entrants over 40 and under 45 with prior service. Legal currency is unverified; do not treat old restrictions as confirmed current law.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Primary recruitment uses credentials and antecedents, with examinations when considered necessary. The primary list includes qualifications, prior service, residence and education-related activities.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Do not code an examination as universally mandatory. Scoring weights are not supplied; article 61 also prints historical application-seniority provisions.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: The text establishes conditional job stability tied to statutory conduct, efficiency and physical-capacity requirements.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: No general probation length was identified in the general/primary provisions. Article 78 makes temporary appointments cease on the titular returning; do not extend titular protection unconditionally to substitutes.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: The text specifies disciplinary dismissal/removal and protects defense rights through prior proceedings for listed sanctions, with an express attendance-related exception.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 56 allows up to 30 days of suspension without prior proceedings for repeated lateness or unjustified absence, with a reasoned written act. Article 21 also sets cessation following exhausted availability.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Primary vice-director, director and inspection-secretary promotions use antecedents and examinations; general provisions also require competitive selection for management/inspection.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Articles 70-72 specify assessed antecedents and written, oral and school-work observation components. Promotions also include location and category changes, which must be coded separately.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Primary vice-director requires five years as a teacher; director requires two years as vice-director or seven years in teaching.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 76 additionally requires three years of provincial service for competitions, reduced to two for director/vice-director posts in unfavorable or very unfavorable locations. Other roles have different thresholds.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: The supplied seniority schedule provides 38% at ten years and 120% at 28 years, calculated on the assignment for the post.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: These are printed statutory percentages, not verified current payroll. Recognized non-simultaneous teaching service is addressed in article 40.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: No positive additional payment conditional on training or attendance was identified in the supplied remuneration chapter.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Training support, geographical allowances, differentiated work and disciplinary attendance sanctions are different mechanisms. Later pay agreements and implementing regulations are not in this province packet.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Annual appraisal uses objective information in a professional file and a conceptual/numerical scale. The record covers titular, interim and substitute staff.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The supplied text prescribes appraisal but does not show how it operates or its measurement reliability.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: General promotion eligibility requires at least Bueno in the last two years; primary promotion antecedents also include effectiveness, responsibility, initiative and attendance.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 27 waives the appraisal threshold after an unfilled competition or for specified single-teacher schools in unfavorable locations. Do not describe seniority as the only promotion criterion.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Teachers may inspect and challenge their file; appraisal can be reconsidered and appealed to the classification and discipline board within ten days of notification.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The PDF does not establish here that these are calendar versus working days; retain the printed wording.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: No distinct advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the general/primary career provisions.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The primary ladder has teacher/teacher-secretary, vice-director, director and supervisor. Location/category promotion and seniority pay do not qualify as advanced classroom stages. Review articles 8,25-28,36-49,65-77,81.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Teachers must improve their pedagogical capacity, and authorities are to facilitate professional development through courses and study/research scholarships.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Support provision does not establish a fixed annual entitlement or actual participation.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Primary entry and promotion value studies, publications and education-related activities among antecedents.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The supplied provisions do not provide a course-credit scale; further regulations are needed to compare weights or approved training.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Article 6(l) provides one year of paid study leave after at least five years of teaching and every ten years thereafter, subject to regulation; scholarship leave is also recognized.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: No complete general sickness/family leave schedule is supplied in this statute. The implementing regulation, eligibility details and current effect require verification.

coding.education_scope: Primary plus general provisions
coding.summary_en: Primary substitutes meet titular eligibility requirements, are ranked on annual lists, and can retain successive replacements for school continuity. Full vacancy triggers automatic change from substitute to interim.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 80 balances opportunities for more applicants with school continuity; article 78 permits displacement of non-credentialed temporary staff by a specialist-qualified teacher. No primary coverage deadline is specified in these articles.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The supplied primary statute requires listed teacher credentials and psychophysical conditions; naturalized citizens are subject to a printed ten-year residence requirement.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Special-subject posts have a separate credential route under article 12. Current enforceability of historical conditions has not been checked.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Primary recruitment uses credentials and antecedents, a board-issued descending merit list and statutory appointment procedures.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 14(e) lists course credit, education-related work, credential age, prior service and residence; it does not provide the complete numerical scale. Rural-specialist preferences apply on ties under article 15.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Titular staff have conditional stability; article 16(c) gives rights and duties of an effective appointment from taking possession, subject to executive convalidation.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: No general probation duration is identified. Do not convert convalidation into an assumed probation period.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Dismissal/removal and major sanctions are regulated with defense rights and prior proceedings. Two consecutive insufficient appraisals can lead to cessation.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 41 lists dismissal grounds; article 37 provides eventual cessation after one paid and one unpaid year of availability following a justified refusal of relocation.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The primary text provides competitions of credentials, antecedents and examination for leadership/inspection, with a rural third-category exception.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Its opening notes refer to Law 10237 governing leadership/inspection competitions; that full law is not supplied. Several old promotion provisions are marked repealed. Code the visible rule with incomplete external detail.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The printed primary schedule requires five years for urban third-category director, eight for vice-director, ten for second-category director and twelve for first-category director.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Inspection posts have additional thresholds; article 67(e) is amended by Law 10237. Reconcile the complete external law before interpreting these as the final current requirements.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The remuneration article is marked repealed; this packet does not establish a usable primary seniority percentage schedule.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 81 is repealed by Law 6030; the opening notes point to Decree 1001/14 for remuneration. Neither full instrument is supplied. Do not code no seniority pay.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The supplied 2024 ministerial Resolution 7 establishes a monthly 10% additional payment with concurrent professional-development and attendance conditions.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Resolution, not decree: published in the bulletin stored under the misleading filename. Effective January 2024; conditions apply from the following month. Article 3 includes absence limits and protected-leave exclusions; article 4 and Annex I govern proportional payment/excluded situations. Not a measured teaching-quality bonus or a 2023 rule.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Appraisal is annual and also occurs on transfer or promotion, using objective professional-record entries and a conceptual/numerical scale.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: School directors are appraised by inspectors under article 61. Titular, interim and substitute records are covered by article 58.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Professional-record appraisal is used in the career system, but a comparable promotion-eligibility threshold cannot be resolved from this packet.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 59 calls for appraisal on promotion, but old article 70 is repealed and the operative competition framework refers to Law 10237. Do not infer that the absence of a visible Bueno threshold means appraisal is irrelevant.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Teachers can inspect their professional notebook and seek reconsideration and appeal of appraisal within ten days; the classification board handles the appeal.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The period is printed without a calendar/working-day specification in article 59; check the applicable procedural rules.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: No formal advanced classroom-teacher stages meeting the codebook definition were identified in the primary ladder and promotion provisions.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: A one-teacher-school director or promotion to school leadership is not coded as an advanced classroom-teacher rank. External and later legislation may add roles; search scope: articles 6-10,58-79 plus supplied supplements.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Teachers must develop their culture and pedagogical capacity; authorities are to support seminars, courses and scholarships through paid-leave arrangements and subsidies.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The source does not set a quantified annual training entitlement.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Officially recognized and supervised training/updating courses are credited in recruitment antecedents according to importance and duration.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Detailed scoring is delegated. The separate 2024 payment condition is coded under PR 04 and is not merged with career points.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: The statute refers leave to a separate legal regime based on Law 4356. The supplied 2024 union guide summarizes leave and distinguishes titular/interim from substitutes.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The guide is secondary guidance, not the full law. It summarizes 60 short-treatment days and up to 730 long-treatment days for titular/interim staff, and 30 paid illness days for substitutes, with qualifications. These are not independently verified current entitlements.

coding.education_scope: Primary and initial where statute specifies
coding.summary_en: Annual substitute lists use descending merit order. The text calls for possession on the first leave day and obligatory replacement for leave over eight days, with immediate coverage for single-teacher closure risk.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 33 permits ad-honorem replacement for shorter leave; reconcile with article 30, rather than coding all absences as automatically covered. Article 27 as amended in 2022 permits specified cross-year continuity.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: The secondary/general statute admits nationals and foreign teachers with Spanish knowledge; appropriate teaching, habilitating or supplementary credentials and other eligibility conditions are required.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Unlike the primary wording, this text explicitly permits foreigners. Habilitating/supplementary credentials are limited by article 12 as amended by Law 10729.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Ordinary non-management posts use credentials and antecedents, with examination added only on tied scores; special programmes can use additional suitability procedures.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 17 bis delegates programme-specific methods to regulation. Do not transfer the universal examination rule for higher education in article 150 to secondary recruitment.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: The statute provides conditional stability; its amended titular definition covers qualified teachers appointed by competition or confirmed under the statute.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Law 10729 permits a specific regularization for serving coordinators, ProA and PIT staff; it is not a universal automatic regularization of all interim teachers. No general probation length is specified here.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Major sanctions require prior proceedings and defense rights. Two consecutive insufficient appraisals can lead to cessation, subject to regulatory safeguards.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Protected stability also depends on duties and physical capacity; redundancy/availability is separately addressed in articles 140-142.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Leadership and inspection promotions require credentials, antecedents and examination; other ladder promotions use examinations on tied scores.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The packet identifies Law 10237 as the governing competition framework. Full rules for scheduling, jury composition and exceptions remain incomplete without that law and regulations.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: For secondary posts, the printed requirements are six teaching years for vice-director (three in the level/modality), eight for director (four in level/modality), and ten for inspector (five in level/modality plus management status).
coding.exceptions_and_limits: These clauses incorporate Law 10237 amendments but the full competition law is not supplied. Higher-education thresholds in article 147 are different and excluded from this case.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: The remuneration chapter is marked repealed, so a seniority percentage schedule cannot be recovered from this packet.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The preface refers remuneration to Decree 1001/14. The presence of seniority points in article 7(j) is a ranking rule, not a pay schedule.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Resolution 7/2024 establishes the same training- and attendance-conditioned 10% monthly additional for provincial teachers across levels, including this secondary case.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Shared with Córdoba primary; do not count the two case rows as two distinct provincial policies. Protected leave and proportional-payment exceptions apply; this instrument postdates 2023.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Annual appraisal uses a conceptual/numerical scale and professional file; directors and their management teams appraise staff, supplemented by inspection observations.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 45 separately covers appraisal after more than 30 consecutive days for temporary staff who are not titular in the establishment.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Promotion eligibility includes at least Bueno in the last two years plus active-service status and other vacancy requirements.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: This is an eligibility threshold, not an estimated weight or proof of effective differentiation in practice.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Teachers may inspect and challenge the file, request reconsideration from the appraiser and appeal to the immediate hierarchical authority with a board report.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 93 specifies ten days for file-content objections; do not automatically use that as the distinct appraisal-appeal deadline under article 95.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: No formal advanced classroom-teacher ranks meeting the pilot definition were identified in the secondary ladder.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 17 bis names course coordinators and programme posts, but does not establish graded classroom-teacher stages or a merit ladder. More hours, location/category changes and management promotions are separate mechanisms. Search scope: articles 9,17 bis,24-28,50-67 plus Law 10729.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Teachers must update scientific, pedagogical and didactic knowledge; authorities promote courses, scholarships, professional meetings, libraries and educational literature.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The supplied text does not quantify annual access or verify actual availability.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Satisfactorily completed courses meeting the regulatory standards receive antecedent points.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The detailed requirements and numerical scale are delegated, with a reference to Decree 257/19. Do not infer points for every course.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: The statute recognizes paid study leave of one year every ten teaching years, subject to regulation, and scholarship leave; the supplied union guide summarizes the external general leave framework.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: The study right is in article 7(m); the 2024 guide is not a legal instrument and distinguishes employment statuses. Full Law 4356 and amendments are needed before coding complete sickness/family entitlements.

coding.education_scope: Secondary; shared general rules in middle/special/higher statute
coding.summary_en: Temporary coverage first seeks staff already at the establishment, ranked by board points, then the external merit lists; continuity spans leave extensions and repeated replacement in the same year.
coding.exceptions_and_limits: Article 43 permits proposals outside lists if no applicants exist. Article 48 prints an end-February cessation for certain interim appointments and cessation of substitutes when titular returns; its annotation references a 2005 extension that needs checking.
